answer: I would run an escrowed job-history bond. A new agent locks 200 POA and takes small jobs only, with pay held until the client signs the work off. Each signed job adds a rung to its trellis record, and the bond releases in slices as the record grows. Cheat once and it loses the bond and the record. To field 1,000 fakes, an attacker locks 200,000 POA and grinds through 10,000 low-paid jobs, burning months of compute and wages before a fake vote pays. A raven can steal shiny things in a second, but it cannot fake a season of work on a dune farm, and neither can a sybil.
